facts.topic: 16K entries, full-page subpage fields, valid bit and T8020 TTBR shift
facts.decision: 8-byte little-endian entries, 2048 entries/page; TTBR=(PA>>12)|bit31; table=PA|bit0; canonical leaf=PA|(0xfff<<40)|bit1|bit0 plus inverse read/write permissions.

facts.topic: T8103 profile narrower than generic m1n1 field descriptions
facts.decision: 32-bit IOVA, 36-bit PA, 16 streams, 16K granule; slot0 only, 128 reachable L1 indices and 2048 L2 indices. Physical encoding bits35:14. Reject higher bits rather than mask them; no T6000/USB4/T8110/gen3 claim. m1n1 C generic mask39:14/sid_count32 is deliberately not treated as T8103 authority.
NO_READ bit8, NO_WRITE bit7; support full-page R/W, R-only, W-only. No-access, partial subpages and unknown encodings rejected. Zero is the only accepted invalid entry.

facts.topic: Concrete APCIE0 aperture and MSI exclusion
facts.decision: Reported captured ADT window base0x100000 size0xbfe00000 => half-open [0x100000,0xbff00000). Not newly observed here. Explicit policy required. Deny whole 16K IOVA page[0xffffc000,0x100000000) containing reported MSI address0xfffff000 even when policy aperture spans it. This is exclusion, not MSI configuration.

RID is exact16-bit BDF, SID<16, slot<64. Reject repeated RID/SID/slot in this exclusive-domain prototype. No inferred bus-to-SID relation, grouped RID mask, phandle-to-SID conversion or allocation. Linux shared Wi-Fi/BT grouping requires separately proven ownership and is unsupported.
